description_en: Modifies the configuration of a customer gateway
description_zh: 调用ModifyCustomerGatewayAttribute接口修改用户网关的配置
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-customer-gateway-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --customer-gateway-id cgw-bp1pvpl9r9adju6l50000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCustomerGatewayAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the customer gateway. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
用户网关所属的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the customer gateway
parameters.name: customer_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the customer gateway.  

The name must be 1 to 100 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
用户网关的名称。  

名称长度为1～100个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the customer gateway.  

The description must be 1 to 100 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
用户网关的描述信息。  

描述信息长度为1～100个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The authentication key of the BGP route routing protocol for the on-premises data center gateway device.

The key must be 1 to 64 characters in length, can contain only ASCII characters, and cannot contain spaces, Chinese characters, or half-width question marks (?)
parameters.help_zh:
本地数据中心网关设备BGP路由协议的认证密钥。

密钥长度为1~64个字符，只支持ASCII字符，不支持空格、中文和半角问号（?）
parameters.name: auth_key

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the customer gateway was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建用户网关的时间戳

CustomerGatewayId.description_en: The instance ID of the customer gateway

Description.description_en: The description of the customer gateway

IpAddress.description_en: The public IP address of the on-premises data center gateway device
IpAddress.description_zh: 本地数据中心网关设备的公网IP地址

Name.description_en: The name of the customer gateway

ResourceGroupId.description_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the customer gateway belongs.

You can call the [ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html） operation to query resource group information
ResourceGroupId.description_zh:
用户网关所属的资源组ID。

您可以调用[ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html）接口查询资源组信息
